site.heroSubtitle: Join the Commerce Club and immerse yourself in the world of business and entrepreneurship.
site.aboutText: Commercium is a community for students who want to explore the world of business beyond the classroom. We combine finance, entrepreneurship, and strategy through interactive events, competitions, workshops, and real-world experiences.
site.aboutGoal: Our goal is simple: help students develop the confidence, skills, and mindset to succeed—whether that's in business, university, or wherever their ambitions take them.

events.title: Annual Commerce Gala Night
events.description: Dress to impress and enjoy a formal evening with fellow commerce enthusiasts. Keynote speeches will highlight the evening.

events.title: Negotiation Skills Workshop
events.description: Learn the art of negotiation with interactive sessions to enhance your skills and techniques in negotiating deals.

events.title: Next Year Project Brainstorming
events.description: Join us for a brainstorming session on innovative commerce project ideas for the next year. Be ready to share and collaborate.

posts.author: Commercium Club
posts.body: Welcome to our group Alumni Network! A home for former Commercium members and leaders who have graduated, moved on, or completed their time at the club but still want to stay connected. Share university experiences, career opportunities, advice for current students, and continue being part of the Commercium community.

posts.author: Commercium Club
posts.body: Welcome to our group Public Community! This is the official community space for everyone who wants to be part of Commercium. Whether you’re a commerce student, a supporter of the club, a teacher, a future member, or simply curious about what we do, this is the place to stay connected. Expect event announcements, club updates, business discussions, opportunities, and community conversations.

announcements.title: Welcome to the new Commercium site!
announcements.body: This is where the club will post official announcements. Check back regularly for event reminders, deadlines, and club news.

articles.title: Getting Started in Business
articles.author: Commercium Club
articles.body: Every great venture starts with a single idea. This first article introduces the mindset and first steps for young entrepreneurs.

achievements.title: Market Day 2026
achievements.description: Our flagship student market day — months of planning, dozens of student businesses, and a school community that showed up in force.

achievements.title: Basics of Starting a Business Workshop
achievements.description: Students took part in the Basics of Starting a Business workshop with Professor Stoyan Stoyanov of HW Dubai.

achievements.title: Money Management & Budgeting
achievements.description: Money Management & Budgeting workshop delivered in collaboration with HW Dubai.

achievements.title: Certified Entrepreneurship Modules
achievements.description: In collaboration with Injaz UAE, Commercium introduced certified online entrepreneurship modules focused on project management and building sustainable, socially responsible businesses.
